description: This file contains the implementation of the vtDeleteWorkflow function which handles deleting workflows in the vtiger CRM system. It verifies admin access, deletes a specified workflow, and redirects the user afterward.

classes.name: VTWorkflowUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for workflow operations, including permission checks and redirections.

classes.name: VTWorkflowApplication
classes.description: Represents the workflow application context, used here to initialize the delete workflow operation.

classes.name: VTWorkflowManager
classes.description: Handles workflow management operations such as delete.

methods.name: vtDeleteWorkflow
methods.description: Main function to delete a workflow identified by workflow_id, with access control checks and user redirection.
